body:
SilverBullet4869 - Staff Application (2)


Age: 15

Timezone: +4 GMT

Do you have Teamspeak? No, but will if I get approved.

Do you have Discord? No, but will if I get approved.

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes

---


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION 


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? 

No.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?

Not being active much during school days, I won't be very consistent.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?

Passion- Must have enough passion to achieve a certain goal, help motivate and inspire other members. Motivating team members help get the best out of them. The leader needs to be an inspiration, if the leader is inspired, generally the reason behind that is because he is doing a good job. If the members are inspired, then they will be motivated to work harder and become like the leader.

Ambition- They must have ambition to succeed. Without ambition to succeed, the team will fail. The leader is a very effective part of every team and they need to have the ambition otherwise, it lets the whole team down and will give team members opportunities to slack off which is harmful for the team.

Desire- The leader must have desire to succeed. If they aren't bothered to help the team and lead them towards success, then the team will fall apart since their main person is slacking off and not willing to do his job properly. This can cause the team to break down.

Quality- The leader must have the quality to be a leader. Leaders usually do better jobs than the people lower than them in the ranks. You cannot appoint a failure to be a leader and have high expectations of them succeeding. Always the person with most quality would usually be the best out of their colleges to doing a higher ranked task.

Brave & Social- The leader must be brave and social enough to talk and consult people about what they are doing whether it is: You are doing this wrong you need to change, or you are doing this right keep it up. If the leader doesn't consult people and give them any feedback the members will not know if they are doing something right or wrong. This can de-motivate the members as they wouldn't know what to do, especially if they are new to a certain job/task. They also must be brave enough to get the team up and motivate them whenever something is not being done right or some progress has been done and the effort has to be kept up. If the leader does not give directions during these situations the members might not be doing their job up to the very best.

I won't consider myself a leader but I usually do give instructions to other people. Usually I am not the best at leading and many other people would be better than me, however if no one wants to be a leader then I would offer myself to be the leader.

The reason is because I am usually not brave enough or social enough to interact with people and help them to what is best for the team. I usually am ambitious and do have quality it is just the social and interaction part that I am shy on.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

Experience- I have been in Avicus for 3 years now. I have been in many situations where staff members had to give the right action to a certain player for a certain reason. From this, I know what to do in a certain situation due to the large amount of times I have witness this situation. Where as, other players might not have been in these type of situation so they will have no clue of what to do if they were in it.

Time Zones- I live in a time zone which is easy to moderate people when no staff are around. I have been on Avicus many times during the day and have seen no staff online, if I was a staff member at that point, hackers would have less fun messing around with people since there is a person who could ban him if they were caught.

Smartness- I am quite  smart when dealing with certain situations, not many people have that. I don't panic if something is not going the way I want to be and pressure isn't a factor that heavily effects me. Other players might not have this trait which can be very key for succeeding.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

Social Skills- If you aren't social with the community then there is basically no use of you being there. Communities are made for people to help each other and interact, if you aren't interactive or social, then you are doing no good to the community.

Being helpful- Many of times people will ask you to do a favour for them, you should be helpful and help them. In the end, everyone needs one another, the world is filled with people to help each other.

Support- If someone is going through a rough period or has something on their mind and they need support, then someone should go ahead and help them and advice them. They should try and make the issue lighter and less of a stress for the victim. This way the victim will relies that people do care about him and can be a motivating factor for their future.

I have all of these skills. Especially the last 2. I get affected quite easily if someone isn't having a good time. I like to help people because of the thought that in the future, when I go through a rough period someone will help me. I have gone through rough periods in the past and I remember getting support so I like to return the favour to others.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

Fair- A moderator needs to be a fair when giving out a decision such as an Infraction. For example, if 2 people are spamming, both of them should get the same punishment as they are both doing the same thing. 

Intelligence- A moderator needs to be intelligent when they are in a difficult situation. For example, if there is a possibility that a player is hacking, the moderator should not rush into a decision and instead, further investigate and record footage. If they are still unsure, the footage should be sent to the people higher ranked to deal with the situation.

Consistency- A moderator needs to be consistent when they are doing their job. They should always try their best and not slack off. There is no use having a moderator who is only online once a month and is very inactive as they are not performing their job well and basically just not care about it. A moderator should always try and perform up to their best.

---


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

Report it to higher rankings to investigate. I will also record him being careless and explain it to the higher rankings to deal with it. If I am on the same rank as him or even lower at staff positions, then I am in no position of performing any action of the situation, people higher ranked have the right to deal with the situation.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

Try and calm the situation down. The situation could get fiery and that will cause some unnecessary and unwanted trouble.


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

Notify them to take it down if I cannot take it down.

Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

I will tell them that those players don't like these actions and will try to stop them. I will try and convince them to stop and that we should respect every person's rights and these actions aren't appropriate. If they still do not stop, I will tell them that the players are getting affected by it and don't accept it, after that I will tell them that they are senior staff members and they are a role model to some players and should not act in an inappropriate manner.

---


CRITERIA 3: OTHER


Why do you want to be a moderator?

I want to help Avicus. Simple as. Quite often, I see hackers with no mods online. Players get extremely frustrated when there are hackers and no mods online and the situation gets out of control. I want to make Avicus a better place for people to enjoy their time without anything affecting them in a bad way.


What does Avicus mean to you?

A lot. I have been playing on this server since 2015. The players are always fun to chat with. Server is just great in general.


Anything specific the staff team could do better?

Be more active. Avicus has a lot of staff members yet, sometimes I barely see any. Most of the time when players are active only 1 or 2 mods are online. During the early hours in my time zone, sometimes I find some people playing without any member of staff online.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

It is 1 of 2 servers that enjoy the most playing at. Hypixel is the other. With Hypixel, the job is tough due to the large amount of players. I have no experience of being a mod. Avicus would be a great way of improving a lot of my skills including: Communication, Experience and Dealing with Situations. Another thing is that because I enjoy playing on this server a lot. I haven't had any experience of being a mod making the chances of me being approved on servers with much more people lower.


Do you have anything else to add to your application

My time zone could be suitable for a mod. However, I will be returning to school very soon, in about 2 weeks time. During school days I don't play a lot of Minecraft as I don not find anything enjoyable when I am busy with school. This would change if I was a staff member, for the simple reason of that I would have something to care about rather than just playing and messing about.


Thank You,

SilverBullet4869.
